newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Solid Group, Sony in venture.
newsitem.headline: Solid Group, Sony in venture.

text.p: Solid Group Inc said on Tuesday it had signed an eight-year agreement with Sony Corp for a local electronics joint venture.
The new firm, to be called Sony Philippines Inc, will have an authorised capital of 104 million pesos. It will be owned 67 percent by Sony and 33 percent by Solid.
"The primary purpose of Sony Philippines...will include the business of selling and marketing Sony audio, video and other products," Solid said in a statement.
On termination of the agreement, Sony can purchase Solid's shares in Sony Philippines at their book value.
